mapper.insert: insert into biz_funnel_daily (stat_date, funnel_code, step_code, source, city_code, user_count, event_count, conversion_rate, create_time, update_time) with normalized as ( select date(event.occurred_at) as stat_date, case when event.event_name in ('community_post_impression', 'community_post_open', 'community_post_qualified_view') or (event.biz_type = 'community_post' and event.event_name in ('content_like', 'content_favorite', 'content_share')) then 'community_post_engagement' when event.event_name in ('content_view', 'content_like', 'content_favorite', 'content_share') then 'content_engagement' when event.event_name in ('signup_start', 'signup_submit', 'payment_success') then 'activity_conversion' when event.event_name in ('template_reuse', 'topic_publish_success', 'activity_publish_success') then 'creator_conversion' else 'general' end as funnel_code, event.event_name as step_code, event.biz_type as source, event.city_code, event.member_id, event.occurred_at, case when event.event_name in ('community_post_impression','content_view','signup_start','template_reuse') then 1 else 0 end as is_funnel_start from biz_event_log event left join community_post cp on event.biz_type = 'community_post' and cp.id = event.biz_id where event.occurred_at >= cast(#{statDate} as date) and event.occurred_at <= timestamp(cast(#{statDate} as date), '23:59:59') and (event.event_name <> 'community_post_qualified_view' or (event.member_id is not null and cp.id is not null and cp.author_id <> event.member_id)) ), funnel_starts as ( select stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code, member_id, min(occurred_at) as first_started_at from normalized where is_funnel_start = 1 and member_id is not null group by stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code, member_id ), aggregated as ( select event.stat_date, event.funnel_code, event.step_code, event.source, event.city_code, count(distinct case when event.is_funnel_start = 1 or starter.member_id is not null then event.member_id end) as user_count, count(1) as event_count, event.is_funnel_start from normalized event left join funnel_starts starter on starter.stat_date = event.stat_date and starter.funnel_code = event.funnel_code and starter.source <=> event.source and starter.city_code <=> event.city_code and starter.member_id = event.member_id and starter.first_started_at <= event.occurred_at group by event.stat_date, event.funnel_code, event.step_code, event.source, event.city_code, event.is_funnel_start ), scored as ( select aggregated.*, max(case when is_funnel_start = 1 then user_count end) over (partition by stat_date, funnel_code, source, city_code) as start_user_count from aggregated ) select stat_date, funnel_code, step_code, source, city_code, user_count, event_count, case when start_user_count > 0 then round(user_count / start_user_count, 4) else 0 end as conversion_rate, now() as create_time, now() as update_time from scored
mapper.select: with qualified_user_posts as ( select event.member_id, event.biz_id, post.author_id as current_author_id, min(event.occurred_at) as first_qualified_at, max(event.occurred_at) as last_qualified_at from biz_event_log event left join community_post post on post.id = event.biz_id where event.event_name = 'community_post_qualified_view' and event.biz_type = 'community_post' and event.member_id is not null and event.occurred_at >= cast(#{startDate} as date) and event.occurred_at <= timestamp(cast(#{endDate} as date), '23:59:59') group by event.member_id, event.biz_id, post.author_id ) select count(distinct member_id) as qualified_user_count, count(1) as qualified_user_post_count, count(distinct biz_id) as qualified_post_count, count(distinct nullif(current_author_id, 0)) as current_qualified_author_count, min(first_qualified_at) as first_qualified_at, max(last_qualified_at) as last_qualified_at from qualified_user_posts
